input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, all challenges were either refuted or found to have no relevant evidence:

H1 (Restatements): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. E11 indicates only reclassifications for presentation purposes, not material restatements that would affect the Services revenue growth calculation.

H2 (One-time items): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. No evidence was found indicating one-time items, non-recurring revenue, or accounting changes that would materially affect the Services revenue growth rate for Q2 2026.

H3 (Category definition changes): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. E15 and E18 confirm that the Services category definition has been consistent, including the same components (amortization of deferred value of services bundled in product sales).

The original evidence from E1 clearly shows Services net sales for Q2 2026 (three months ended March 28, 2026) was $30,976 million versus $26,645 million for Q2 2025 (three months ended March 29, 2025), representing 16% year-over-year growth. This exceeds the claim's threshold of "more than 10%". The calculation: (30,976 - 26,645) / 26,645 = 0.1626 or 16.26% > 10%. The verdict remains SUPPORTED.
